import re

def build_search_re(expression):
    """Build search regex from expression."""
    # Check if this is left-aligned: (.+?) followed by space*
    if re.search(r'\(\.\+\?\)\s+[\\]?\ *\*', expression):
        # Replace (.+?) * with \s*([^ ]+) .*? 
        # This captures non-space content preceded by optional whitespace,
        # then matches anything until the rest of the pattern
        match = re.search(r'(\(.*?\))(.*?)(\s+[\\]?\ *\*)(.*)', expression)
        if match:
            prefix = expression[:match.start(1)]
            capture = match.group(1)  # (.+?)
            padding = match.group(3)  # \s+[\\]?\ *\*
            suffix = match.group(4)   # rest of expression
            return prefix + r'\s*([^ ]+) .*?' + suffix
    
    # Check if this is center-aligned: space*(.+?)space*
    if re.search(r'[ ]+[\\]?\ *\*\(\.\+\?\)', expression):
        match = re.search(r'([ ]+[\\]?\ *\*)(\(.*?\))(\s+[\\]?\ *\*)(.*)', expression)
        if match:
            leading = match.group(1)
            capture = match.group(2)
            padding = match.group(3)
            suffix = match.group(4)
            return expression[:match.start()] + leading + r'\s*([^ ]+) .*?' + suffix
    
    # Default: keep original
    return expression

expressions = {
    "default": "a (.+?) c",
    "left": "a (.+?) * c",
    "center": "a  *(.+?) * c",
}

for name, expr in expressions.items():
    result = build_search_re(expr)
    print(f"{name}: {expr!r} -> {result!r}")
    
    compiled = re.compile(result)
    texts = [
        " a b c ",
        " a hello world c ",
        "text a hello world c more text",
    ]
    for text in texts:
        m = compiled.search(text)
        if m:
            print(f"  search({text!r}) -> group(1)={m.group(1)!r}")
        else:
            print(f"  search({text!r}) -> NO MATCH")
    print()
